items.name: Khoerul Amir
items.text_id: Pertama kali menggunakan jasa kontraktor Bangun Asa lewat TikTok. Alhamdulillah, tidak mengecewakan. Overall pengerjaan rapi, sesuai RAB. Tim juga komunikatif. Hasil bangunannya juga bagus. Semoga tetap konsisten menjaga kualitas bangunan, dan semakin dikenal di masyarakat luas. 👍👍👍
items.text_en: I first used Bangun Asa as my contractor after finding them on TikTok, and I’m happy to say I wasn’t disappointed. Overall the work was neat and matched the cost estimate (RAB). The team also communicated well, and the finished building looks great. I hope they keep up the quality and become more widely known. 👍👍👍

items.name: Edy Masrur
items.text_id: Saya renovasi rumah dengan jasa Bangun Asa. Hasilnya sangat memuaskan, melebihi ekspektasi saya.
items.text_en: I renovated my house with Bangun Asa. The result is very satisfying, beyond my expectations.

items.name: Siti Mu’assaroh
items.text_id: Timnya ramah, gercep, dan mampu mewujudkan rumah impian saya. Timnya ramah dan enak diajak diskusi. Nggak asal mengerjakan, tapi juga memberikan saran yang sesuai dengan kebutuhan yang saya pengen. Semoga lancar pembangunan rumah saya.
items.text_en: The team is friendly, quick to respond, and able to turn my dream home into reality. They are friendly and easy to discuss with. They don’t just build for the sake of it, they also give advice that fits what I want. I hope my house construction goes smoothly.

items.name: Talia
items.text_id: Kesan pertama yang saya dapat adalah pelayanannya profesional. Mulai dari admin, tim survei, sampai tim lapangan, pekerjaannya baik semua.
items.text_en: My first impression was how professional the service is. From the admin, to the survey team, to the field team, everyone does good work.

items.name: Indah Puspita
items.text_id: Sebelum pembangunan dimulai, ternyata ada pembahasan teknis dulu, jadi semua detailnya dibicarakan bersama. Bagus, biar nggak ada salah paham saat pengerjaan.
items.text_en: Before construction began, there was a technical discussion first, so every detail was talked through together. That’s good, so there are no misunderstandings during the work.

items.name: Afiq
items.text_id: Terima kasih, layanannya sangat memuaskan, dan kalau saya servis juga langsung cepat eksekusinya.
items.text_en: Thank you, the service was very satisfying, and when I needed after-sales service they acted quickly.
